## Japanese language

**Instructor of Japanese — Centro de Idiomas MAB** (Pelotas-RS, 2009–present)

I have taught Japanese at all levels, from beginner to intermediate, for over fifteen years. I hold the JLPT N2 certificate (Japan Foundation / JEES) and completed the Japanese Language Teacher Training Program (Attain Corp.) and the teacher training course of the Centro Brasileiro de Língua Japonesa (CBLJ).

My pedagogical research focuses on active learning methodologies and distance education applied to Japanese as a foreign language.

## Higher education

**Assistant Professor — Faculdade Anhanguera de Pelotas** (2014–2017)

Undergraduate courses taught in Engineering (Production, Mechanical, Civil) and Biological Sciences:
